The '''Imperial Automated Defense Corps''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] defense division of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[CR-97]] was a unit in the Defense Corps.<ref name="TORE" />
